question: Surya Namaskar term is related to which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yoga**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **Surya Namaskar** is a sequence of physical postures and breathing exercises originating from **Yoga**. It is also known as the "Sun Salutation." 
• The practice includes a series of 12 poses that flow seamlessly and are performed in a sequence. Each pose corresponds to specific movements and breathing techniques. 
• **Surya Namaskar** is traditionally performed early in the morning while facing the sun, as it is believed to energize the body and mind by harnessing the sun's energy. 
• It combines physical movements with spiritual elements, including chanting and mindfulness, making it a holistic exercise beneficial for physical, mental, and spiritual well-being. 
• Practicing **Surya Namaskar** regularly can improve flexibility, strength, balance, digestion, and cardiovascular health. It is popular among yoga practitioners worldwide. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Yoga:** 
• Yoga is an ancient Indian practice that combines physical, mental, and spiritual disciplines to achieve harmony and self-awareness. 
• It originated thousands of years ago and is mentioned in sacred texts like the **Vedas** and the **Upanishads**. 
• There are different types of Yoga, including **Hatha Yoga**, **Ashtanga Yoga**, and **Kundalini Yoga**, each focusing on specific techniques and goals. 
• Yoga is recognized globally for its therapeutic benefits, including stress reduction, improved concentration, and better physical fitness. 
• **Surya Namaskar Sequence:** 
• The 12 poses of Surya Namaskar include **Pranamasana** (Prayer Pose), **Hasta Uttanasana** (Raised Arms Pose), **Padahastasana** (Hand-to-Foot Pose), and others. 
• Each pose is synchronized with controlled breathing techniques, enhancing oxygen intake and energy flow in the body. 
• It is often performed in sets, with repetitions depending on the practitioner’s stamina and goals. 
• In addition to physical benefits, Surya Namaskar is believed to stimulate the **chakras**, or energy centers, promoting spiritual growth. 
• **Benefits of Surya Namaskar:** 
• Improves **flexibility** and strengthens muscles and joints. 
• Promotes better **cardiovascular health** by increasing heart rate and circulation. 
• Enhances **digestion** and helps in weight management. 
• Reduces **stress** and anxiety by calming the mind and improving focus. 
• Boosts overall **energy levels** and contributes to mental clarity. 
• **Global Popularity:** 
• Yoga, including Surya Namaskar, has gained worldwide recognition, with International Yoga Day celebrated annually on **June 21**. 
• Countries like **India**, **USA**, **Australia**, and **UK** have embraced Yoga as part of physical education and wellness programs. 
• Famous personalities, including **PM Narendra Modi**, have advocated Yoga as a tool for holistic health. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• Surya Namaskar is suitable for individuals of all **ages**, with modifications available for beginners and people with health conditions. 
• It is recommended to perform Surya Namaskar on an empty stomach for maximum benefits. 
• The practice can be enhanced by incorporating chants like the **Gayatri Mantra** or specific Surya Namaskar mantras. 
• Surya Namaskar is a cornerstone of Yoga practices and is often taught as part of introductory Yoga sessions. 
• Regular practice can lead to improved **posture**, better respiratory health, and increased mindfulness.
